subject: Mosaic Analytics: persistent deferred completions & remediation coordination
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverline.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production: rising deferred completions and 5xx rate (Mosaic)

Hi Vanessa,

We're seeing a sustained increase in deferred completions and a spike in 5xx errors across our API surface starting ~2026-08-29 22:00 UTC. P95/P99 tail is expanding dramatically for the personalization endpoint; we've observed request pileups where some requests remain "deferred" for minutes and then either time out or return 503.

Attached: mosaic-error-sample.log.txt and a p99-dashboard-screenshot.png. Key metrics: 5xx up ~3x from baseline, deferred-count up ~8x, and throughput is falling as retries balloon. This is affecting nightly jobs and customer-facing features.

Can you confirm whether this maps to any known capacity events or concurrency caps on your side? We need a short-term mitigation and a timeline for a fix. If possible, we'd like executive visibility — our CS and engineering leadership are joining this thread.

Thank you,
Samir
Ops Lead, Mosaic Analytics

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverline.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: rising deferred completions and 5xx rate (Mosaic)

Samir — thanks for the data and the quick heads-up. We're prioritizing this. Short summary of next steps from our side: (1) temporary latency-safe throttles: we'll cap concurrency for the personalization route to reduce KV-cache thrashing, (2) immediate fallback routing to a lighter model variant for high-latency requests, (3) enable aggressive prefix KV-cache retention for this tenant.

I'm looping in Dev (runtime) and Markus (capacity) and Grace (CS lead) to coordinate the war room. Can you confirm the exact SDK versions and whether Mosaic is using streaming completions for the affected call paths? Also please share the HubSpot ticket id or any internal incident id so we can sync audit trails.

I've uploaded an initial mitigation checklist (proposed-mitigation-checklist.pdf) and a console link: https://console.redwood.ai/requests?account=mosaic&range=2026-08-29_to_2026-08-31

Will be on standby — let's target a 30-min sync and an exec readout if the mitigations don't reduce deferred counts.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverline.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: rising deferred completions and 5xx rate (Mosaic)

Adding context from runtime: we see queue buildup on the personalization-serving pool, high lock contention on KV-store writes for large prefix updates, and a correlated rise in token-generation retries that cascade into deferred completions. Immediate actions we can take (short-term, <2 hrs):

- Apply a soft concurrency cap at the per-tenant route level: reduce max_parallel from 64 -> 24 for the personalization route (expected drop in tail volume by ~60%).
- Switch a subset (20%) of traffic to the quantized model variant (q4) to reduce per-token latency spikes; this can be done with a rollout policy and auto-fallback if error rate increases.
- Temporarily disable large prefix updates (TTL bumping) for non-critical users to reduce KV churn.

Commands (ops):
- redwoodctl routing set --tenant mosaic --route personalization --concurrency 24 --immediate
- redwoodctl rollout start --tenant mosaic --model personal-q4 --percent 20

I recommend we schedule a live war-room in the next 20–30 minutes to apply these and watch telemetry. I'll standby to run commands and revert if anything regresses.

— Dev
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverline.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Tina Li <tina.li@silverline.ai>, dev_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: rising deferred completions and 5xx rate (Mosaic)

Vanessa/Dev — thanks. We ran the SDK trace requested: Mosaic is on SDK v3.4.1 and using streaming completions in a subset of personalization flows. We can disable large prefix updates and are open to routing a portion of traffic to the q4 variant.

Result of your short-term mitigations: after you applied a 24-concurrency cap and rolled 20% to q4, deferred counts dropped ~45% within 40 minutes but we still have a non-trivial tail and intermittent 503s for ~1–2% of requests. Our leadership is requesting an exec-level call and a proposal for a credit/compensation if the issue persists over the next 48 hours.

Timeline request: please provide (A) targeted timeline for full restoration, (B) whether this indicates a cluster-level resource shortage vs a workload-pattern (KV churn) issue, and (C) postmortem owners.

Samir
Ops Lead, Mosaic Analytics

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@silverline.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: rising deferred completions and 5xx rate (Mosaic)

Samir — quick update and next steps. Executive call scheduled: 2026-09-02 17:00 UTC (Redwood Eng Director + VP CS + Mosaic Head of Ops). Agenda: state, short-term mitigations applied, timeline for full remediation, and a compensation remediation path if SLA thresholds are crossed.

Short answers to your bullets: (A) Targeted timeline: stabilization expected within 24 hours from combined mitigations; full remediation (root cause fix + rollout) estimated 5 business days pending capacity rebalancing or KV-store tuning. (B) Current signal: primarily workload-driven KV churn amplified by concurrency caps hitting our older routing policy; not a wholesale cluster outage. We're provisioning temporary reserved capacity while the engineering fix is implemented. (C) Postmortem owners: Dev Patel (runtime) + Markus Klein (capacity) + Grace O'Connor (CS) — we'll publish a rolling incident timeline and notify you when the postmortem draft is ready.

Attachments: proposed-mitigation-checklist.pdf (applied items marked) and incident console link: https://console.redwood.ai/requests?account=mosaic&range=2026-08-29_to_2026-09-02

We appreciate the collaboration — we'll join the exec call and escalate to leadership if the deferred counts do not fall further.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
